notes.title: Building the world of Echo - The First Tower!
notes.content:
[p]Since we were really gameplay-heavy in our first year here, I believe it’s time to dive into some visuals and a bit of lore about this world we’re creating![/p][p][/p][p]The entire games story is set inside the Kings castle. How big is this castle? Huge…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/639a3e2ebc0f7b50b8363071a06a3d06d13acf79.png"][/img][/p][p]Without getting into spoiler territory, the castle got corrupted by a demonic ritual gone wrong, and now it is slowly turning into a festering and rotten reflection of itself. But! Before all that happened, it was a very nice place with a lot of military power and prestige.[/p][p][/p][p]Inside the lowest layer of the castle reside the soldiers. The first line of defense for the castle it is decorated by the most efficient and imposing design. Inside these spaces, you will encounter:[/p][p][/p][p]                                                                   [b]Training grounds[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/20f4eae35350261e428fdd0316917802787dd2c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]                                                                           Artillery hangars[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/c452ecdda6e055d1859cf036192d0c85f3f3dc87.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Weapon racks, training dummies, sleeping hammocks, etc.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/bc848ba2790432a285427de3d5c1972be6b66ad7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Imposing pillars and statues[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/e80f0b4834c4bf8f548c1c18976d01ea73224daa.png"][/img]The King is in constant war with the other royals of the continent and the army never rests. New soldiers arriving to be trained as well as veterans standing guard for years to ensure the safety of the royal family.[/p][p][/p][p]This is, of course, just the concept art. We’re keeping the reveal of how these rooms will actually look for you to experience when you play the Demo! Other than the soldiers, there are residents that you can interact with, but that will be a later post since I really want to go into detail and they deserve a post of their own. [/p][p][/p][p]If you want to step into the first tower and face off against the soldiers, then join our playtesting group on Discord![/p][p][/p][p]The next post will go into detail on a new mechanic reveal btw, so see you soon![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Making the Echolocation - Our journey into sound and darkness!
notes.content:
[p]                                                 Story time - [b]From matchsticks to sound waves![/b][/p][p][/p][p]When we started making [b]Echo: Defy Death[/b] [i](we were still calling it Echo Ninja then btw, just so you know my naming sense is complete garbage xD)[/i] or first step was to get that echo shader looking like sound is revealing the area and not light.[/p][p]                                                                       [b]The First Draft[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/35b0840e4aa309adc66bf9124b74f8fef6d87dab.gif"][/img][/p][p]The first draft was like a cookie cutter effect type of shader. Black screen with circles spawning and revealing everything behind them. It was enough to start working on the combat and other game mechanics but we had a whole lot of issues with it. Liiiiikeeee:[/p][olist][*][p][b]It was too flat[/b].. Like the background felt like a poster rather than space…[/p][/*][*][p][b]The outline was too sharp[/b] and confusing[/p][/*][*][p]There was literally no difference between light and this. [b]It didn’t look like sound.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p]So naturally, we went into a cave and learned echolocation from the bat gods [i](jk, we don’t have bat caves where we come from so we weren't lucky enough to try this out)[/i]. Jokes aside we had some ideas on what to do to make it come to life.[/p][p][/p][p]                                                                     [b]The Second Draft[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/2bae2df03bb831557a7a9615f7cb7fc7e14d6166.gif"][/img][/p][p]This was the upgraded version. [b]We smoothed out the edges, then added a 3D background to add depth and the all important ‘’pulse’’ effect[/b] to really make it feel like a sound wave rather than someone lighting a match. With this we were like [i]‘’Yup, we’re awesome.’’[/i] but then came the game design part.[/p][p][/p][p]                                                                       [b]The Final Draft[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004337/806b29434d8ba7518624d61107723cb08432a0a5.gif"][/img][/p][p]For the latest version we made the echolocation travel in a straight line to ‘’mimic’’ the sense of echolocation, and we also made the sound wave bounce off surfaces. This made the echolocation feel more intentional and better for navigation while keeping the combat exciting. We added in distortion if you spam it too often and only sounds made from combat were circular since they we’re not controlled sounds. This is where we stand currently and we’re liking it very much. Next step is to smooth this distortion out, make the fading smoother as well and try and get that ‘’pulse’’ effect to be even better and look a lot more like sound.
[/p][p]That was our journey from matchsticks to echolocation. We’re going to be sharing some more stories of our development like this so you know we’re working hard on delivering an awesome game and thank you all so much for the support! [/p][p][/p][p]If you're up for testing the game out then join in on our [b][url="https://discord.gg/chN3J4TaSk"]Discord[/url]![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you have an awesome week, peace![/p]

notes.title: Echo: Defy Death has received new funding from Wings Interactive!
notes.content: [p]Echo: Defy Death has received new funding from [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41840602"]Wings Interactive[/url],[/b] marking a major milestone in our journey. notes.title: New secondary weapons and visual updates!
notes.content:
Hi all! We've been working very hard these months, and we’re making every second count. We're implementing a lot of systems and entire visual updates, so we wanted to share some of the things we added to give you a sense of progress! 

[b]A new echo shader and the environment is now entirely 3D! [/b]
[list]
[*] We really wanted to make the echo feel like sound waves, and we really like this direction we’re taking with 3D environments and the sound of "scanning" the area. It made the entire game feel a lot deeper and more immersive! [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TdKB--pigNYv7GvfUaSWRKpWHVflrA8q/view?usp=drive_link]New echo shader preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Ultimate move now has starting animation![/b]
[list]
[*] There is no point in making a cool blind ninja game without some awesome animations before executing a killer move so we’ve started our work on creating the unique in which we will represent the ninjas attacks and personality and it really makes the move pop! [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SrJ9Og1dSKzhRBuGZlP2Av_F_RwcUA0J/view?usp=sharing]Ultimate move animation preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Environmental echolocation tools![/b]
[list]
[*] You can now use the environment to help you in combat and reveal bigger areas and many more uses and utilities! The Gong is my favorite at the moment since it openly invites all enemies to attack you but also reveals the entire room. [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ovfpHn5ssq6KM8YXjory0OSbG-4cBblz&usp=drive_copy]Gong preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Secondary weapons and loudness![/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a few secondary weapons to the game of which i think the most visually interesting one is the Great Club you take from the heavy enemies. It delivers a devastating attack and launches a powerful sound wave making the impact feel even stronger. [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1H1f5vwEpBAkRSzXvnr2xBYZsekczpLwO&usp=drive_copy]Heavy weapon preview[/url]
[/list]
That’s just a small part of all the massive system updates we’re making, but this had enough visual appeal to be shown by our pretty rough standards. Also, we’re working on a lot of enemies and environments which we believe we will share very soon so stay tuned. Thank you so much for all of your support as we continue working to make the best echolocation roguelite game ever!
